start: Members page, gym with the member app on and members who joined in the app

steps.action: Open Members and tap the tab 'Joined in the app'
user_sees: Subtitle 'Who has the MettleUp app on their phone'
Line 'Members who joined your gym in the MettleUp app with gym code <CODE>.'
One card per app member: name, 'Joined <time ago> · last seen <time ago>', '1 order' / '<n> orders' / 'No orders yet', '<amount> paid for shop orders' or 'No shop orders paid yet'
must_not: A member of another gym in the list
'Loading…' that never ends
A gym-wide money total on this list

steps.action: Tap a member whose mobile number is in the gym's member list
user_sees: That member's own page opens
must_not: Another member's page opens (wrong match by mobile number)
The add form opens for someone already in the list

start: Joined in the app list, an app member whose number is not in the gym's member list

steps.action: Look at the member's card
user_sees: Extra line 'Not in your member list yet. Tap to add them.'
must_not: The line shown for a member who is already in the list

steps.action: Tap the card
user_sees: The add-member form opens with the name filled in and the mobile number filled in with +91 and the last 10 digits
must_not: A member saved without the person pressing save
A number from another country rewritten to a wrong +91 number without a word
An empty form

start: Members page, gym that has not turned on the member app

steps.action: Tap 'Joined in the app'
user_sees: Card 'Let members order from your gym in the MettleUp app.' with 'Turn on the shop to get your gym code. It comes with 12 sample products you can change or delete.' and the button 'Turn on the shop'
must_not: An empty list that reads as 'nobody joined'
An error
A gym code shown before the shop is on

steps.action: With the app on, turn the internet off and wait for the next refresh (every 60 seconds)
user_sees: A red line with the reason on top; the list already loaded stays
must_not: 'Nobody has joined in the app yet' shown because the load failed
The list wiped

start: Joined in the app list of a gym where nobody has joined yet

steps.action: Open the list
user_sees: 'Nobody has joined in the app yet' with 'Ask members to open the MettleUp app and join with gym code <CODE>. They show up here at once.'
must_not: A blank page
A count of members

steps.action: A member joins the gym in the app; keep the list open
user_sees: The member's card appears by itself on the next refresh (the list re-reads every 60 seconds), with 'No orders yet' and 'Not in your member list yet. Tap to add them.'
must_not: The member never appears until the page is reloaded
The member shown twice

steps.action: Add the member to the gym's list with the same mobile number, then come back
user_sees: The 'Not in your member list yet' line is gone; a tap now opens the member's page
must_not: The card still offers to add a member who was just added
A second member row made by tapping again

start: Joined in the app list, signed in as owner

steps.action: Read what each card shows about a member
user_sees: Name, when they joined, when the app was last seen, how many shop orders and how much was paid for shop orders
must_not: The member's workouts, weight or health entries
A member who joined another gym
The member's full mobile number printed on the card

steps.action: Sign out, then open the address of the list
user_sees: The sign-in page
must_not: The list shown to someone who is not signed in to this gym
